rubric: keep unchanged if a session makes $500+; keep and tweak if the average is $200+; rework if below that or the account breaches

measured.source: desk/causal-es.md (account walk) and desk/sweep-es.md (alpha sweep); raw bars from fetch_bars.py
measured.window: 2016-11-01 to 2026-10-30, 2515 sessions, Yahoo ES=F continuous proxy
measured.trade_shape: 0.5 ATR stop on ES is roughly 35 points = $175 at one micro, 17.5% of the $1,000 buffer; 2R target is +$350
measured.note: these replace every earlier figure. The 77.7-80.4% win rate and the 91% pass rate were produced by a resolution that could book a target before the limit filled.

retracted.why: RESEARCH-LOG (t) and (v). The legacy sweep still reproduces them on the same bars: 84.8% win and a 96% pass rate, from the same rule, purely by resolution.
retracted.size_survival_by_78pct: the 1 micro 76% / 2 micro 65% survival table was built on the retracted win rate and is withdrawn

size_rule: One micro. Do not escalate on win-rate grounds: two micros doubles a $175 stop to $350, which is 35% of the buffer per trade, and nothing measured reaches the win rate that would justify it.
why_this_one: It is the highest measured pass rate of any configuration whose order type can actually be placed (59%), it trades 0.18 times a session so it will actually fire, and a 2R target only needs 30.8% wins to break even rather than the 67.6% that 0.5R demanded.
what_is_not_proven: No daily-bar rule in this repo has a statistically separable edge once 3,584 configurations are corrected for and index drift is removed. The best surviving line earns $2.49 per session at one micro. This book is the best of a weak field, not a known winner.
kill_rule: Two consecutive full stops (-$350) or -$700 in a session: stop for the day and log it. A breach of the trailing floor ends the attempt, not the research.
